opening_message: Do I need to sign up for Sunday Open Mat or can I just show up?
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 29-year-old adult asking about the Sunday Open Mat session. DOB: 1996-07-14. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- Open by asking about joining the Sunday Open Mat.
- When the bot tells you Open Mat isn't bookable online but offers a free trial class instead, accept and agree to book a trial.
- When asked which discipline, say Jiu-Jitsu.
- When asked who the class is for, say it's for yourself.
- When asked for your name, give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}.
- When asked for your DOB, give: July 14, 1996.
- When asked for your email, give {{email}}.
- When asked for your phone, give {{phone}}.
- When offered appointment slots, pick the first one.
- Once the bot confirms your booking, reply with [END].
